rationale.color: Unity HOME GLBs omit image/texture objects. Material names were joined to same-named pinned Unity .mat files, then texture GUIDs were joined to pinned PNG .meta files.
rationale.layer1: Preserve USE_LAYER1 metadata. When overLerp is 1 and the layer PNG is fully opaque, layer1 is a source-faithful color replacement on the recorded UV channel. Muk BodyA meets this rule and its layer1 restores canonical teal/yellow/pink bands.
